How do AI solutions work for small businesses? AI solutions for small businesses work by connecting to your existing tools (email, chat, documents, and customer data) and using machine learning to automate repetitive work, answer questions, route support requests, and generate content on demand. For example, an AI assistant connects to your inbox and calendar to draft responses, summarize threads, and schedule follow-ups. An AI-powered contact center uses natural language processing to understand customer questions, route them to the right agent or self-service answer, and learn from each interaction. You don't need to build or train models. AWS Partners configure pre-built solutions for your specific workflows and data. How much does AI cost for small businesses? The cost of AI depends on your usage levels and the models selected. AWS AI services use a pay-as-you-go pricing model, so small businesses can control costs and scale as they grow. To estimate costs for your business, use the AWS Pricing Calculator . Why AI Matters for Small Businesses? AI matters because it helps small businesses do more with limited time, budget, and staff.
